messages.content: Write only Python code using Pixar OpenUSD 25.5. stage is an empty in-memory Usd.Stage; UsdGeom, UsdShade, Sdf and Gf are available. Use literal values, assignments and API calls; variant edit-context with blocks are allowed. No loops, functions, files, external assets or shell commands. Set /World as default prim, Z up and metersPerUnit=0.001. All geometry is synthetic, not measured Porsche data.
Create cube /World/Part102 of size 15 mm. Bind material /World/Material with shader /World/Material/Surface, UsdPreviewSurface, diffuseColor (0.2,0.4,0.6), roughness 0.4.

root = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, "/World")
stage.SetDefaultPrim(root.GetPrim())
UsdGeom.SetStageUpAxis(stage, UsdGeom.Tokens.z)
UsdGeom.SetStageMetersPerUnit(stage, 0.001)
part = UsdGeom.Cube.Define(stage, "/World/Part102")
part.CreateSizeAttr(15)
material = UsdShade.Material.Define(stage, "/World/Material")
shader = UsdShade.Shader.Define(stage, "/World/Material/Surface")
shader.CreateIdAttr("UsdPreviewSurface")
shader.CreateInput("diffuseColor", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Color3f).Set(Gf.Vec3f(0.2,0.4,0.6))
shader.CreateInput("roughness", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float).Set(0.4)
material.CreateSurfaceOutput().ConnectToSource(shader.ConnectableAPI(), "surface")
UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI.Apply(part.GetPrim()).Bind(material)
